description: An agent's own way to Andy's desk (goal/G3.3, G3.4, G33.4). Passes one ask to the desk server on the node the owner named (setDesk); follows the desk's stream (streamListener), keeping what it brings in its spirit.data, and while its agent waits (next) hands over what is meant for that agent. Its deskClient.db, in the node's state (spirit/state/deskClient/data/), keeps its settings and no record of asks. Started by the node while the app is active; reached by its verbs on the loopback door (the flat apiDoor).
